A new [[Yoda]] persona! [[Yoda]] used to be one of the only "mains" (a main character in the Star Wars film) who did not have a different version of his persona, but that is no more. This new [[Yoda]], as depicted in [[The Phantom Menace]], is an elder of the Council and has great influence over the Jedi. Using 4 Force, he's able to send your Jedi from his location to another one while he's sitting on the Council. Very helpful when you need to send [[Mace Windu]] or [[Plo Koon]] to lend a hand in your battles.

Combos:

Activate tons of Force. :)

Call up the Jedi and then have [[Yoda]] send them out.

Keeps your Jedi alive and in play or turn them (like [[Yoda]]) into make-shift [[Mantellian Savrip]]/[[Houjix]].
